reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Vaul (https://vaul.emilkowal.ski/).
Technology stack: react, typescript, radix-ui.
Component specification: 最后开 Default。Preview 里 Open Drawer，下面还有侧向抽屉。
Key visual & interaction patterns: Dialog.
Visual details from source observation: 域名仍是 vaul.emilkowal.ski。首页就一句 Drawer component for React，按钮 Open Drawer。Getting Started 给出 pnpm i vaul 和 Drawer.Root 骨架。打开 Default：Preview 里 Open Drawer，下面 Side drawer、Nested、Scrollable。适合要手机式抽屉、样式自己写的人。MIT。依赖 @radix-ui/react-dialog。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
